August 2021 cover of Vogue US. For the cover shoot, Annie Leibovitz photographed Biden on the White House balcony overlooking the South Lawn wearing Tiffany earrings and a floral Oscar de la Renta dress designed by Laura Kim and Fernando Garcia.
- Advertisement -
 If you like our blog, please consider buying us a happy coffee by clicking on this 
link. Thank you! ☺
For the cover story, Leibovitz also captured photos of the First Lady working from home in the White House, spending relaxed time with her grandchildren and a romantic shot of the presidential couple cuddled on a White House garden patio. Fashion editor Tonne Goodman selects the designs of 
Ralph Lauren and Michael Kors Collection.
- Advertisement -
In the interview, Biden speaks with Jonathan Van Meter about being an educator (and continuing to teach, even after moving into 1600 Pennsylvania Ave.), using her platform and more.
